create.name: Marie Manuchehri
create.bio:
Marie Manuchehri is an energy healer, intuitive and medium from the Seattle area. She is a registered nurse and worked for years as an oncology nurse in a hospital, where she first noticed her intuitive perceptions and began working with energy. She is also a Reiki master and teaches Reiki attunement workshops.

Her teaching centres on what she calls multisensory awareness: learning to recognise intuitive information, raising your own energetic vibration, and connecting with spirit guides and loved ones on the Other Side. She teaches through live and recorded online courses, short practice-based recordings on subjects such as automatic writing, fear and the energy of money, retreats, and her long-running podcast, Where Energy Meets the Divine, which is also on her YouTube channel. She has recorded several self-paced courses with The Shift Network, including Multisensory Mediumship, and is the author of the Sounds True audio programme How to Communicate with Your Spirit Guides. Her style is warm and practical, mixing guided meditation, qigong-style movement and plain explanation.

courses.title: Multisensory Mediumship
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on connecting with loved ones and guides in the spirit realm. It combines meditation, seated qigong and practice in recognising multisensory impressions.

courses.title: Stepping Into the Veil (2-part course recording)
courses.description: A downloadable two-part recorded class on how the veil between worlds thins as consciousness grows, with tools for connecting with loved ones, guides and angels.

courses.title: The Meditative Art of Automatic Writing (2-part course recording)
courses.description: A downloadable two-part class in which Marie teaches her daily method of automatic writing as a meditative practice for clarity and guidance.

courses.title: Fear; the Last Frontier (2-part course recording)
courses.description: A downloadable two-part class on where fear comes from, working with the fear-driven ego, and stepping into your ability to manifest.

courses.title: Receiving the Energy of Money (2-part course recording)
courses.description: A downloadable two-part class on money as energy and how to relate to and receive it.

courses.title: Embrace Your Intuition (digital download)
courses.description: A recorded teaching with stories, exercises and meditations for developing your multisensory intuition and using it in everyday choices.

flags: Her brand is medical intuition (she describes herself as a medical intuitive and her private practice gives insight into clients' health). Applied the medical rule strictly: every medical-intuition course, her one-to-one sessions and Power Sessions, her health recordings and her book Intuitive Self-Healing are left out. What remains is mediumship, intuition and manifestation teaching. A human should decide whether a listing is appropriate at all.
Her Shift and website bios contain health claims (reversal of illness, releasing disease); none were used in the bio.
Instagram and Facebook follower counts could not be read; only YouTube (17.5K) is counted.
No books: How to Communicate with Your Spirit Guides is a Sounds True audio programme with no Amazon book listing found; Intuitive Self-Healing is left out as a health book.
Multisensory Mediumship price is the current Shift sale price ($297 USD, regular $347 USD).
Contact email is a Gmail address (mariemanuchehri@gmail.com) published on her contact page.
